maddeler.e:
نكفهر (form IVq)
# نَكْفَهِرُّ (nakfahirru) /nak.fa.hir.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
# نَكْفَهِرَّ (nakfahirra) /nak.fa.hir.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
# نَكْفَهِرِّ (nakfahirri) /nak.fa.hir.ri/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِكْفَهَرَّ (ikfaharra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
